title: Photoshop Can Now Move the Light in Your Photo
excerpt: Relight, currently in Photoshop beta, lets you reposition, soften, and recolor the lighting in a finished image. The catch: every finished render costs 30 generative credits.

title: Why f/16 Makes Every Photo a Little Softer
excerpt: Diffraction is the one blur no lens can outrun. Here is how much sharpness f/16 actually costs, why there is no magic cliff, and when to stop down anyway.

title: Twenty Years of Fall Color, One Shot List
excerpt: Photographer Kate Garibaldi spent twenty Octobers learning that great fall photography is not about chasing peak color. It is about planning the variety of shots before you leave home.
